_doc: NPC dialog for the Scald gate.

dismissive: The Scald isn't a place. It's a verdict.
You haven't even settled things with that Sable kid on the route.
Come back when your drake has scars worth reading.
acknowledged: Hm. Sable came through here muttering about you.
So the ember generation has teeth after all.
The trial cave isn't ready for visitors yet. Soon, hatchling. Soon.

gate.text: A gate of scorched brick. It will not open until you have faced Sable on the Dustway.
